nodes.label: Solar power-flow diagram
nodes.rationale: PV, grid, inverter, home and battery nodes with animated flow links; battery shows voltage instead of percent.

nodes.label: Layout: two-column named-area grid
nodes.rationale: HTML order matches visual order so keyboard and screen-reader order follow the screen; collapses to one column below 760px.

nodes.label: Creative North Star: The Morning Brief
nodes.norm_label: creative north star: the morning brief
nodes.rationale: A quiet daily briefing read at a glance; dark, calm page can sit on a screen all day and dim at night without glaring.

nodes.label: Daily self-update at 04:15 to test-passed versions
nodes.norm_label: daily self-update at 04:15 to test-passed versions

nodes.label: Docker container on always-on box (Proxmox LXC)
nodes.norm_label: docker container on always-on box (proxmox lxc)

nodes.label: Purpose: home power state (solar/battery/grid, battery runtime)
nodes.norm_label: purpose: home power state (solar/battery/grid, battery runtime)

nodes.label: Secrets stay on the server; admin-password-protected settings
nodes.norm_label: secrets stay on the server; admin-password-protected settings
nodes.rationale: API tokens are never sent to the browser.

nodes.label: Flow links (pv, grid, load, battery) with badges and dashes
nodes.norm_label: flow links (pv, grid, load, battery) with badges and dashes

nodes.label: Header (eyebrow, profile select, LIVE dot, Settings button)
nodes.norm_label: header (eyebrow, profile select, live dot, settings button)

nodes.label: Settings: Solar section (provider, fields, battery kWh)
nodes.norm_label: settings: solar section (provider, fields, battery kwh)

nodes.label: Solar diagram nodes (PV, Grid, Inverter, Home, Battery)
nodes.norm_label: solar diagram nodes (pv, grid, inverter, home, battery)

nodes.label: Minimum container requirements
nodes.rationale: 1 vCPU, 512MB RAM, 8GB disk, Debian 12, LXC nesting for Docker, port 4123/tcp.

nodes.label: Test-gated daily update
nodes.rationale: morning-desk-update.timer only installs commits whose GitHub Test workflow passed; otherwise keeps current version; SKIP_TEST_CHECK=1 overrides.

nodes.label: The 11px Floor Rule
nodes.rationale: No text renders below 11px at any width, including the solar diagram on phones.

nodes.label: Cheap continuous effects (transform/opacity only, reduced-motion alternative)
nodes.norm_label: cheap continuous effects (transform/opacity only, reduced-motion alternative)
nodes.rationale: Runs on cheap always-on hardware; no layout-property animation loops or continuous CPU/GPU cost.

nodes.label: Elevation and depth (ambient shadow, night mode overlay)
nodes.norm_label: elevation and depth (ambient shadow, night mode overlay)

nodes.label: Ember Coral (#ff846c)
nodes.rationale: Live and attention: LIVE badge, Sky News LIVE tag, destructive actions, grid flow.

nodes.label: The Glow-Means-Live Rule
nodes.rationale: A coloured glow appears only on something currently active; idle elements stay flat.

nodes.label: Header navigation (title, profile switcher, LIVE/OFFLINE, Settings pill)
nodes.norm_label: header navigation (title, profile switcher, live/offline, settings pill)

nodes.label: Inline SVG line icons via icon() helper (Lucide shapes)
nodes.norm_label: inline svg line icons via icon() helper (lucide shapes)
nodes.rationale: Constant 1.5px line, currentColor, round caps; never emoji or text glyphs.

nodes.label: The Meaningful Flow Rule
nodes.rationale: Colour encodes power source: green solar/load, cyan battery, coral grid; never recolour for looks.

nodes.label: Morning Lime (#c7ff47)
nodes.rationale: The one action/focus colour: primary buttons, focus ring, caret, power readout, active news indices.

nodes.label: Neutral colours (Ink, Overcast Grey, Slate Panel, Night Page, Hairline)
nodes.norm_label: neutral colours (ink, overcast grey, slate panel, night page, hairline)

nodes.label: The One Action Rule
nodes.rationale: Lime means act here / you are here; never decorative.

nodes.label: Signal Cyan (#58e2ff)
nodes.rationale: Links and the battery.

nodes.label: Solar diagram night-blue palette and flow colours
nodes.norm_label: solar diagram night-blue palette and flow colours

nodes.label: Solar Flow Diagram (signature component)
nodes.rationale: Night-blue instrument with PV, grid, inverter, home, battery nodes; dashes animate with transform only for cheap rendering, static gradient under reduced motion.

nodes.label: The Steady Numbers Rule
nodes.rationale: Refreshing numbers use tabular figures so they never jitter.

nodes.label: Typography (Manrope + DM Mono)
nodes.rationale: Manrope is round and friendly; DM Mono adds an instrument feel for labels, timestamps and diagram readouts.

nodes.label: Principle: Light on hardware
nodes.rationale: Every feature must justify its running cost on low-power always-on devices.

nodes.label: nginx reverse proxy
nodes.rationale: Must pass Host and X-Forwarded-Proto so login cookie and same-site check work.

nodes.label: Admin Password
nodes.rationale: Anyone can view, only admin changes settings. Salted scrypt hash in config.json, 12h sessions cleared on restart, lockout after 8 wrong attempts for 10 minutes; first visitor claims it unless ADMIN_PASSWORD is set.

nodes.label: TRUST_PROXY
nodes.rationale: Only trusts X-Forwarded-* from a trusted proxy (default loopback) so clients cannot fake addresses to dodge the login lockout.

nodes.label: config.json
nodes.rationale: Gitignored and mounted into the container so Growatt tokens are not committed; now version 3 with per-profile solar block.

nodes.label: Growatt solar provider
nodes.rationale: Tokens never leave the server; browser only learns whether a token is saved.

nodes.label: Profile
nodes.rationale: Bundles location, solar account and news channels per household/site/person; selectable via ?profile=<id> for wall displays.

nodes.label: Config schema migration (v3)
nodes.rationale: Older single-profile and growatt-block configs upgrade automatically on next save; rollback requires copying token back by hand.

nodes.label: Solar provider plugin
nodes.rationale: One file per vendor in providers/ returning a common shape; settings form drawn from provider field list; minIntervalMs for strict API quotas vs 15-minute dashboard poll.
